verdict.rationale: Shopify POS is explicitly marketed as an integrated system for merchants scaling their sales, and Shopify's platform is built on a unified admin where catalog/inventory/customers are shared across all sales channels including online store; docs confirm POS is core to Shopify's commerce stack. missing for 10: explicit documentation detailing real-time inventory sync mechanics between POS and online store, and independent/hands-on confirmation of unified customer records across channels.
